title: The Remote — Sc144: kids burst in, Richard tackles them for the remote

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Multi-character staging in one master animation symbol: the whole family's performance is nested inside a single 'animation' symbol placed over white + background, instead of one scene layer per character. Entrances, a run cycle and a tackle are choreographed inside the nest where all the timing can be seen together.
notes: Scene timeline is only 3 working layers: animation / white / background — all character work is nested in the 'animation' symbol (1,413 keyframes).
Contains a nested 'gb run cycle' (375 kf) and Nicole's mouth comp (349 kf): cycles and face comps are shared library assets dropped into the nest.
Highest motion sum of the wave (136,609) — this is the most physical scene in the set.
